description: This is a PHP test class named DispatcherTest which defines unit tests for the FastRoute dispatcher implementation. The class contains abstract methods that must be implemented by subclasses to specify dispatcher and data generator classes. It provides various test methods to verify correct dispatcher behavior, including dispatch success, not found, method not allowed, and routing errors. Data providers supply multiple test scenarios with routing configurations and expected outcomes.

classes.name: DispatcherTest
classes.description: Abstract PHPUnit test class for testing FastRoute dispatcher implementations, providing methods to verify dispatch outcomes with various routing configurations.

methods.name: getDispatcherClass
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the dispatcher class to be tested.

methods.name: getDataGeneratorClass
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the data generator class for routing.

methods.name: generateDispatcherOptions
methods.description: Private method to generate configuration options for Dispatcher, including data generator and dispatcher classes.

methods.name: testFoundDispatches
methods.description: Test method to verify correct dispatching when routes are found, using data provider 'provideFoundDispatchCases'.

methods.name: testNotFoundDispatches
methods.description: Test method to verify dispatcher returns NOT_FOUND for unmatched routes, using data provider 'provideNotFoundDispatchCases'.

methods.name: testMethodNotAllowedDispatches
methods.description: Test method to verify dispatcher returns METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED when method is not allowed, using data provider 'provideMethodNotAllowedDispatchCases'.

methods.name: testDuplicateVariableNameError
methods.description: Test that duplicate placeholder variables in routes trigger BadRouteException.

methods.name: testDuplicateVariableRoute
methods.description: Test that duplicate routes with the same path and method trigger BadRouteException.

methods.name: testDuplicateStaticRoute
methods.description: Test that duplicate static routes with same method and path trigger BadRouteException.

methods.name: testShadowedStaticRoute
methods.description: Test that a static route shadowed by a variable route triggers the correct exception.

methods.name: testCapturing
methods.description: Test that route regex containing capturing groups causes BadRouteException.

methods.name: provideFoundDispatchCases
methods.description: Data provider supplying various route configurations and expected dispatch results indicating matching routes and extracted parameters.

methods.name: provideNotFoundDispatchCases

methods.name: provideMethodNotAllowedDispatchCases
methods.description: Data provider with route configurations and requests expecting 'method not allowed' responses, including allowed methods.
